items.title: nexu-io/opengame
items.why: It demonstrates how multiple AI coding agents can work together to help build and customize video games.
items.summary: OpenGame is an open-source platform that orchestrates multiple AI coding agents to create and modify games.

items.title: DeadInternetStudios/100x-engineer-skill
items.why: It provides a practical tool to improve the code generation quality of AI developer tools.
items.summary: 100x is an open-source prompt framework designed to turn standard LLM prompts into cleaner, formally verified code.

items.title: alesha-pro/llm.asm
items.why: It is an impressive showcase of low-level assembly programming running a machine learning model from scratch.
items.summary: llm.asm is an open-source project that runs an LLM directly on bare-metal hardware using pure x86-64 assembly code.

items.title: erkamyaman/safe-anything
items.why: It helps you practice security best practices by scanning your code and AI agent setups for vulnerabilities.
items.summary: Safe Anything is a fast vulnerability scanner written in Rust that detects security flaws and leaked secrets in code bases and AI setups.

items.title: gary23w/f-ck_data_brokers
items.why: It is a great example of a practical Python script built to automate personal privacy tasks.
items.summary: fck_data_brokers is a free Python script that sends automated data deletion requests to data brokers on your behalf.

items.title: 1Password Security Incident
items.why: Security notices from major software tools like 1Password are important to follow as a software developer.
items.summary: Password manager 1Password disclosed a security incident, sparking widespread discussion around account security and credential safety.

items.title: Woman evicted after landlord's AI assistant told her she could delay rent
items.why: It highlights the real-world risks when people rely on automated AI tools for crucial communication.
items.summary: A tenant was evicted after an automated AI landlord assistant inaccurately informed her that she could delay her rent payment.

items.title: AI made self-hosting fun again
items.why: It offers perspective on how modern AI coding tools make running your own web services much simpler.
items.summary: This article discusses how AI assistants have made setting up and managing self-hosted personal applications accessible and fun again.

items.title: US Air Force's cloud computing platform hacked
items.why: It highlights a major cybersecurity breach affecting critical military cloud infrastructure.
items.summary: Reports indicate that the US Air Force cloud computing environment experienced a security breach by hackers.

items.title: Zelensky criticises 'strange' Trump-Putin friendship in BBC interview
items.why: It gives you an update on key international diplomatic developments regarding the war in Ukraine.
items.summary: Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelensky criticized US diplomatic approaches toward Russia and called for stronger international pressure to end the war.

items.title: Parts of US clean up after Thanksgiving storm lashes East Coast
items.why: It covers a major natural event affecting infrastructure and power across the US.
items.summary: A severe holiday storm brought heavy rain, wind, and snow to the US East Coast, leaving hundreds of thousands without electricity.
